description: This file defines the ListFeedQuery class which implements feed query functionality for OrchardCore Lists module, including matching and executing feed requests, generating RSS or other formats, and querying related content items.

classes.name: ListFeedQuery
classes.description: Implements feed query provider and execution logic for OrchardCore Lists, supporting RSS and other formats, and querying related content items.

methods.name: MatchAsync
methods.description: Determines if the current feed context matches this query, returning a match object or null.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes the feed query, generating feed content based on the content item and format.
